headline: The zero-shot function-vector effect is still DETECTABLE but MUCH WEAKER on 2026 multimodal-arch models: mean top-1 FV accuracy at the peak edit layer falls from Llama-2 92.2% / OLMo-2 89.3% (2023-25) to Qwen3.5-9B 16.9% (present-past 47.5%, antonym/country-capital near-zero) and gemma-4-12B antonym 18.0%. FV > no-FV baseline in every completed task, so the causal effect is real but small; the peak edit layer stays mid-to-late (~0.52 depth, depth/3 still broken). CAVEAT: the 2026 FV was built with transformers forward-hooks on GQA/multimodal attention (nnsight cannot wrap these; gemma-4 has mixed head_dims), so part of the attenuation may be methodological, not purely a model property.

notes: RECOVERY RUN: compute finished at SLURM walltime; a /net/projects2 read-only storage outage blocked the card write. This card is pure CPU post-processing of existing on-disk fu2_summary.json results - no GPU, no model loading, no FV/nnsight/transformers re-run. All outputs staged under /net/scratch/haokunliu/fv003-recovery/; copy_back.sh lands them in the run dir once projects2 is rw.

METHODOLOGICAL CAVEAT (do not read as a clean model property): the 2026 FV head decomposition used transformers forward-hooks on the attention out-projection input of GQA/multimodal attention because nnsight cannot wrap these architectures; gemma-4 has mixed head_dims [256,512]. Part of the measured attenuation may be imperfect head decomposition, not purely weaker FVs in the models. The shape-guard passed on both models.
gemma-4-12B is a PARTIAL/bonus 2026 point: only antonym completed before the outage; country-capital/present-past were descoped (missing on disk) and are NOT invented.

Causal control: zs_fv_peak > zs_baseline_peak in every completed task (real, if small, effect). Shuffled-label control is mixed: SL FV > SL base for Qwen3.5 present-past (22.0 vs 11.9) and gemma-4 antonym (71.7 vs 40.7), but SL FV < SL base for Qwen3.5 antonym/country-capital (the near-failure tasks).

2021-2025 ladder rows (GPT-J, GPT-NeoX, Llama-2, Qwen2.5, Qwen3-8B, OLMo-2) reused VERBATIM from FV/results/per_model_001/consolidated.json + the 001 result_card; GPT-J/NeoX anchors from the 001 replication artifacts. 2026 rows: bf16, seed 42, 3-task subset {antonym,country-capital,present-past}, same CIE cost cap.
